title: High entropy biphasic oxide cathode materials for sodium-ion batteries to mitigate performance degradation
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,794-803
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01012D, Paper
Yusong Wang, Yingshuai Wang, Lei Liu, Ziye Wang, Xiangyu Ding, Qingbo Zhou, Shaowen Huang, Hexiao Zhang, Hongcai Gao
O3-type materials with lower sodium content have been designed by improving the configuration entropy of the material and increasing the oxygen defects in the material. The stability of the material was improved by the biphasic tailoring strategy.
